items.prompt: What does the risk-neutral p mean here?

options.why: It need not equal the real-world up probability.

options.text: Guaranteed frequency of future up moves
Probability the strategy will make a profit
The stock physical return parameter estimated from historical observations
options.why: The model pricing weight comes from replication and the gross risk-free return, not a historical return fit.

items.explanation: Risk-neutral pricing is not market-direction prediction.
